description: This source file defines the core model class 'NodeAppModel' for the iOS application in the OpenClaw project. It manages application state, network sessions, device capabilities, notification handling, and interaction with various services and gateways. It also handles commands for camera, canvas, system notifications, chat, and other device functionalities, integrating multiple subsystems and external APIs.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Error type wrapping notification call errors, conforming to Error and Sendable.

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable struct representing relay identity response with deviceId and publicKey.

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: A synchronization primitive to wrap async notification calls, ensuring they complete within a timeout.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
